svg.title: Pixel-art developer works from 4 AM to sunrise, then dresses, packs a bag and leaves
svg.desc: A looping pixel scene of a cozy room with string lights, shelf, poster, sticky notes, a sleeping cat and a city skyline in the window. The sky moves from night to a full sunrise while the developer codes. He then stands, takes his jacket from the hook, shoulders a bag holding a laptop, books and a pen, and walks out the door on the right.
